text: I think you'll really enjoy this recipe for Delicious Brown Edge Wafers! It features large eggs, which are a staple in many of the recipes you've liked in the past. The addition of vanilla is also a common thread in your preferred recipes, and the combination of butter and sugar will likely satisfy your sweet tooth. The fact that this recipe is quick to make, ready in about 30 minutes, is also in line with your typical cooking time. Give it a try and see what you think!
